description: Wasserschutzgebiete in der Stadt Cottbus is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Mapping of water protection areas in the district-free city of Cottbus - original maps or verbal descriptions of the protection zone boundaries from the original water protection area decisions or the regulations according to the BbgWG. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas in the city of Cottbus" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2011-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
